description: Coastal Engineering Collaborations between NC State and Nagoya Universities is a dataset listed in DesignSafe Data Depot (published projects), a research data repository for natural hazards engineering under the section "simulation", published or maintained by Joel Dietrich, North Carolina State University (ncsu.edu). Our project focuses on advancing knowledge and technologies to evaluate large adaptations for coastal cities, with a focus on ship allisions to bridges and storm surge barriers. While numerous studies have predicted the benefits of these adaptations in reducing flooding, much less is known about how they may interact with ships, especially ship allisions. Coverage: Francis Scott Key Bridge. DesignSafe files it as a "simulation" project. Keywords: Dali, Francis Scott Key Bridge, collision, crash, FS3M, ADCIRC. Published 2026-01-16. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is ODC-By-1.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support structural performance, hazard exposure and resilience studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-designsafe-data-depot-repository.
